core_obligations: Embed the limit: the limit is the intersection, inside the product of the spaces, of the closed subsets determined by the graphs of the transition maps (proof lines 2699-2708)
Closedness: that intersection is closed because each of the defining subsets is closed (proof lines 2709-2713)
Conclusion: the product of quasi-compact spaces is quasi-compact, so the limit is closed inside a quasi-compact space and hence quasi-compact (proof lines 2713-2714)
